text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
So that's what happened—I get it now!
Years ago,
on that fateful day, the
prankster kaiju was born!
In other
words...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You got that right! Today's the day I go
wild!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Awaken! On this happy day, you have
been
reborn. Welcome, Sixth
Ranger—Nom-Nom
Knight!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Naw, that's lame. If I become your ally,
then
there'll be nobody for me to bite.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
You foolish creature! Now that it's come
to this, I
shall vanquish you with my
Birthday Bash.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Here I go! Take my ultimate move—Happy Birthday Attack! Happy birthday! Happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And don't forget my Celebratory Dance Attack!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Now, to finish you off! Finale Present Crash!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... this role-play could use some
work.
